name: Therzok
summary: In Orgrimmar, Therzok waits for a promising rogue from Durotar. Kaplak has seen your skill with violence and stealth and sends you to the Cleft of Shadow to meet a Shattered Hand operative.

sections.title: A Whispered Summons
sections.body: Kaplak draws promising young rogues aside when they begin making a name for themselves in Durotar. The new Horde honors Thrall, but not all its servants fight openly beneath his banner. Word of a fighter skilled in violence and stealth, willing to bend the rules of open warfare, reaches the underground guild in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Into the Cleft of Shadow
sections.body: Kaplak sends you beneath Orgrimmar's red stone cliffs to the Cleft of Shadow. Therzok waits in its gloom, out of sight of the city's grunts. There, lone cutpurses and ambushers are brought into the Shattered Hand, the Horde's covert network of daggers in the dark.

faq.answer: Therzok is a Shattered Hand operative in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He meets promising young rogues arriving from Durotar's training grounds and brings them into the guild's service.

faq.q: Why does Kaplak send me to him?
faq.answer: Kaplak sees your skill in combat and your talent for stealth and subterfuge. He knows the Shattered Hand seeks capable scoundrels, so he passes Therzok's request to recruit you.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand is a secret guild of assassins, spies, and thieves serving the Horde. They handle necessary, morally difficult work that Thrall's honorable warriors cannot perform openly.

faq.q: Where is the Cleft of Shadow located?
faq.answer: The Cleft of Shadow is a cavern beneath central Orgrimmar. Dark passages lead down to it from the Valley of Strength and the Drag, and it shelters the city's warlocks and rogues from public scrutiny.
After you greet Therzok, he introduces the duties of Shattered Hand service and assigns work to test your capability, stealth, and loyalty to the network.
No. Only rogues receive this summons after reaching a certain level of experience, marking their move from local skirmishes into the Horde's intelligence network.

angles.text: As a rogue, this summons brings you into the Shattered Hand, linking your solitary work in Durotar to the Horde's organized spy network.
As a member of the Horde, you know Thrall preaches honor and the warrior spirit. Therzok's network shows the Horde also relies on unseen blades and secret intelligence gatherers.
